correctness.rationale: Disjoint ordered witnesses of dep(x,y)∨dep(y,x) biject with orientations of the labelled bipartite team graph having outdegree <=1. Connected components must be trees or unicyclic: v roots for each tree, 2 cycle directions for each unicyclic graph, zero for components with e>v. An integer-break upper bound on 2d vertices is attained by balanced alternate left/right paths for every residue mod3. Disjoint partial-function inclusion-exclusion over matched common edges gives Z_{p,q}; rooted bipartite tree and cycle species give EGF exp(L+R−LR)/(1−LR). Fresh brute enumeration of all p,q<=3 team masks directly labelled partitions and all 65,536 four-by-four component counts matched maxima 2,4,9,18, global totals 3,47,2074,183249 and satisfying teams 2,16,460,33959.
